description: Capability for every T4 Git window: the main one and the `w<n>` windows `spawn_window` creates for a torn-off tab or a restored layout. The dialog permissions are listed one by one rather than as `dialog:default` so each one names the call it is there for (JSON takes no comments): `allow-message` is the plugin command behind `ask()` (the native discard / stage / resolve confirmations), `allow-open` the file and folder pickers (open a repository, Locate git…, Locate a tool…), and `allow-save` the Files tab's Save as…, which writes a file at a revision wherever the native save dialog points. `core:window:allow-close` is the last tab of a secondary window closing it (`lib/appWindow.ts`); neither it nor `allow-set-title` is part of `core:window:default`.
